scope.name: Menu-first Coin Champ refinement and local customer journeys
limitations: No production deployment or Supabase changes.
Chrome and WebKit are local desktop engines with viewport/touch emulation.
Visibility events were synthetic; actual browser bfcache, physical audio/safe areas/zoom and installed Capacitor remain unverified.
No student usability study was performed.

test_identity_refs: Disposable isolated local browser guest contexts

checks.expected: The start gate holds, resumes, and cancels safely.
checks.observed: Native timer startup and 3, 2, 1, START sequence passed; Help/visibility hold; Escape cancels.
checks.authorization_ref: User requested Coin Champ refinement and local testing

checks.journey: Count, make, change, retry, success and timeout
checks.expected: Coins, answers, retry guidance and Next remain usable.
checks.observed: 23 Chrome flow assertions and 19 WebKit assertions passed, including all eight counting rounds and first-hint guidance.
checks.authorization_ref: User requested Coin Champ refinement and local testing

checks.expected: Opening shows menu and preserves the saved round without duplicate awards.
checks.observed: Selections and round identity recovered; tickets/correct totals stayed settled after reopening.
checks.authorization_ref: User requested Coin Champ refinement and local testing

checks.journey: Menu, countdown and four play types at seven sizes
checks.expected: Zero document overflow, offscreen actions or occluded action centers at normal tested sizes.
checks.observed: 42 primary states plus 17 interaction/result states passed geometry checks from 320x568 through 1440x900.
checks.authorization_ref: User requested Coin Champ refinement and local testing

checks.journey: Embedded menu, solved answer, Continue, Games
checks.expected: Menu stays in game; Games emits existing exit; solved answer emits one point event.
checks.observed: All five checks passed; one five-point event and unchanged coin-champ exit contract.
checks.authorization_ref: User requested Coin Champ refinement and local testing

checks.journey: Physical phones/tablet, zoom, audible playback and native resume
checks.expected: Responsive controls, safe areas, audio and lifecycle work on physical hardware.
checks.reason: No physical session or installed APK/IPA was run.
checks.authorization_ref: User requested Coin Champ refinement and local testing

summary.next_action: Local requested behavior is verified; complete physical Android/iPhone/iPad and installed-shell checks before claiming all-device acceptance.
